targets.rawSql: SELECT s.start_time AS "Start", s.project AS "Project", COALESCE(s.selected_model, (SELECT mm.model FROM session_models mm WHERE mm.session_id=s.session_id ORDER BY (mm.input_tokens+mm.output_tokens+mm.cache_read_tokens+mm.reasoning_tokens) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "Model", st.total_tokens AS "Total Tokens", st.input_tokens AS "Input", st.output_tokens AS "Output", st.cache_read_tokens AS "Cache Read", st.reasoning_tokens AS "Reasoning", s.premium_requests AS "Premium Reqs", round(s.api_duration_ms/1000.0) AS "API Secs", s.complete AS "Complete", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT k.skill, ', ') FROM session_skills k WHERE k.session_id=s.session_id) AS "Skills", s.cwd AS "CWD", s.session_id AS "Session" FROM sessions s JOIN session_totals st ON st.session_id=s.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time) AND s.project IN (${project:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.start_time DESC

SELECT to_char(s.start_time,'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' '||COALESCE(s.selected_model,'?') AS "Session", st.total_tokens AS "Total Tokens" FROM sessions s JOIN session_totals st ON st.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) AND s.project IN (${project:sqlstring}) ORDER BY st.total_tokens DESC LIMIT 20

list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM sessions WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
